definitions.title: L'Hôpital's Rule (Indeterminate Forms 0/0 and inf/inf)
definitions.statement: If lim f(x)/g(x) produces an indeterminate form 0/0 or (+-oo)/(+-oo), and if lim f'(x)/g'(x) exists or is +-oo, then the limit of the quotient equals the limit of the quotient of their derivatives.
conditions: Limit of derivatives must exist or diverge to +-inf
definitions.explanation: Differentiating numerator and denominator separately evaluates the ratio of their instantaneous rates of approach to 0 or infinity.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Never apply quotient rule when applying L'Hôpital's Rule; differentiate numerator and denominator independently.
